Title: Search word matches the course title
Steps: Type a word that appears in a course title (e.g. "live") and submit
Expected Result: Courses whose title contains the word are returned

Title: Search word matches a category level (category/second_category/parent_category)
Steps: Type a category word from the story's own example ("english") and submit
Expected Result: Courses under that category are returned even though most of their titles do NOT contain the word ""english""

Title: Search word matches another category level
Steps: Type the story's other category example ("business") and submit
Expected Result: The course tagged under that category is returned even though its title does not contain the word ""business""

Title: Search word matches the main teacher (author)
Steps: Type a real instructor's name word (e.g. "margaret") and submit
Expected Result: Courses authored by that teacher are returned even when title/category do not contain the word

Title: Search word matches a teacher via the instructors relation (not necessarily the main author)
Steps: Type a word that only appears as an instructor/author name (e.g. "instructor") and submit
Expected Result: Courses are returned via the author/instructors relation even though the word is absent from every returned title

Title: Mixed multi-word query — one word from category + one word from teacher name (story's ""business sara"" pattern)
Steps: Type a two-word query combining a category word and a teacher-name word (e.g. "english margaret", the real-data equivalent of the story's "business sara" example) and submit
Expected Result: Only courses that satisfy BOTH words are returned (AND across words
column7: OR across fields) — result is the subset of the teacher's courses that also fall in that category

Title: Multi-word query narrows within the same category chain
Steps: Type two words that both belong to the same category chain (e.g. "pearson math") and submit
Expected Result: Total result count is <= the smaller of the two single-word searches; never larger

Title: Case-insensitive matching
Steps: Search the same word in UPPER, lower and Mixed case (e.g. "PEARSON" / "pearson" / "Pearson")
Expected Result: Identical total result count and course list regardless of case

Title: Partial word / prefix matching
Steps: Type a partial word that is a prefix of a real title term (e.g. "assist" for "Assistant")
Expected Result: Courses containing the full word are still returned

Title: Extra whitespace between words is ignored
Steps: Type the same two-word query with extra leading/trailing/inner spaces (e.g. " eman   pearson ")
Expected Result: Same total result count as the trimmed two-word query

Title: No match anywhere returns the empty state
Steps: Type a random string that matches nothing in any field (e.g. "zzzznotfound") and submit
Expected Result: "Nothing to see here" empty-state message is shown and no course cards render

Title: One matching word + one non-matching word returns zero results
Steps: Combine a valid word (e.g. "margaret") with a nonsense word (e.g. "zzzznotfound") and submit
Expected Result: Zero results — AND logic must fail the whole query if any single word has no match in any field for a course

Title: Special characters do not break the page
Steps: Type special characters (@#$%^&*) into the search box and submit
Expected Result: Page remains stable/visible; no JS/server error; no results or a safe empty state

Title: Very long search string is handled gracefully
Steps: Type a 200+ character string into the search box and submit
Expected Result: Page remains stable; no crash / 500 error

Title: Empty search shows the full unfiltered course list
Steps: Type a term then clear the field and submit
Expected Result: Full unfiltered course list is shown again (no q filter applied)

Title: SQL / script injection attempt in search box
Expected Result: No SQL error page; no script executes; page remains stable
